extent.covers: the Greek fragments of the second letter, as Funk and Diekamp print them, from chapters 2, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13 of their numbering
extent.lacks: the rest of the letter, which survives whole only in a Syriac translation
extent.reason: The Greek original is lost apart from quotations (chiefly in Antiochus of Saba's Pandect); the whole letter survives in Syriac (ed. J. T. Beelen, 1856), of which no open transcription was found
